questions.question: How many wicketkeeping dismissals separate the all-time #1 (Mieke de Ridder) and #2 (Tebogo Macheke) wicketkeepers (T20)?
questions.explanation: Mieke de Ridder: 36 — Tebogo Macheke: 26 — a gap of 10.

questions.question: At which ground did Boitumelo Seikaneng record their career-best bowling figures (3-8, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Kei on 2024/12/01.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2014 season?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Knights or Lions?
At which ground did Titans record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 421, against Limpopo Lillies on 2011/02/27.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Micaela Andrews holds it with 26, a joint record shared with Jané Winster.
